mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale_returns (sale_id, shift_id, refund_total, method, reason, restock, created_by) VALUES (#{saleId}, #{shiftId}, #{refundTotal}, #{method}, #{reason}, #{restock}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO sale_return_lines (return_id, sale_line_id, product_id, quantity, amount) VALUES (#{returnId}, #{saleLineId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sale_returns WHERE sale_id = #{saleId} ORDER BY id
